name: Ysley
desc:
Ysley was a powerful figure in [The Hive](faction:the_hive). He cleared Operator Polaris Enigvidion of wrongdoing after discovering the truth and recognizing his abilities. Ysley recruited Polaris into a higher order within the Hive.

Ysley was a later wielder of the Ysley's Pyre Keeper once belonging to a High Curator of the Hive. Originally crafted by the 2nd Greatlord as a gift to the pacifist 3rd, the weapons went unused for years until Ysley acquired them. Unlike the 3rd Hivelord, Ysley restored them as instruments of combat.
additional_info: -   Creator of Curse of Ysley's Ember.
